title: TELOS — 42 Axioms of Systemic Intelligence
description: Machine-readable formalization of the TELOS axiom constitution. Each axiom carries a formal predicate suitable for automated verification.

axioms.name: Architecture Produces Outcomes
axioms.meaning: The pipeline is a pure structural engine; outputs determined by architecture, not heuristics.

axioms.name: Process over Outcomes
axioms.predicate: ∀ d: DecisionTrace captures integrity, not just results
axioms.meaning: DecisionTrace captures integrity, not just results.

axioms.name: Multi-Level Governance
axioms.predicate: TrustManager authorizes streams at mission context level
axioms.meaning: TrustManager authorizes streams at mission context level.

axioms.name: Computational Conservation
axioms.meaning: Every cognitive process consumes finite computational resources; sum of all resource usage is bounded.
axioms.implementation: BudgetManager caps per-cycle compute; ResourceGradientTracker tracks per-dimension utilization

axioms.name: Governance First
axioms.meaning: ReadinessEngine and ConstraintValidator check before action.

axioms.name: Feedback Loops
axioms.meaning: InfraManager observes results and adjusts parameters.

axioms.name: Kintsugi
axioms.predicate: ∀ f ∈ Failures: f ∈ FailureLedger (recorded as asset, not discarded)
axioms.meaning: Failures are recorded as structural assets, not discarded.

axioms.name: Path Dependency
axioms.meaning: All decision functions are history-aware.

axioms.name: Delayed Causality
axioms.predicate: adaptive_horizon adjusts simulation depth based on stability
axioms.meaning: Adaptive horizon adjusts simulation depth based on stability.

axioms.name: Reflection Is Episodic
axioms.meaning: Reflection operates on a slower timescale than action; structurally separated as post-action phase.
axioms.implementation: ReflectPhase runs after Act; IntrospectionScheduler provides cycle/100/1000 cadence

axioms.name: Meta-Error Attribution
axioms.meaning: Every failure identifies the subsystem responsible, enabling targeted correction.
axioms.implementation: ErrorAttributionEngine — subsystem-level attribution with health tracking

axioms.name: Maintenance vs Recovery
axioms.meaning: System preserves integrity before increasing capability; recovery mode tightens policy on failure.

axioms.name: State Maintenance
axioms.predicate: BudgetManager reserves slices for lower-priority streams
axioms.meaning: BudgetManager reserves slices for lower-priority streams.

axioms.name: Option Decay
axioms.meaning: Skills not matched within prune_age_cycles are archived.

axioms.name: Exploration vs Exploitation
axioms.predicate: UCB ∧ Thompson sampling for domain exploration
axioms.meaning: UCB + Thompson sampling for domain exploration.

axioms.name: Structural Inertia
axioms.meaning: Non-selected streams get influence boost to compete.

axioms.name: Curiosity Seeks Broken Models
axioms.meaning: Curiosity is driven by novelty, surprise, and prediction error; the system seeks situations where its model is wrong.
axioms.implementation: UnknownUnknownDetector finds blind spots; CuriosityDrive rewards learning rate; AssumptionAuditor questions held beliefs

axioms.name: Identity Shapes Decisions
axioms.meaning: Identity is maintained through continuous structural consistency; SemanticDepth 4-layer ladder; bounded updates.

axioms.name: Exploration/Comfort Trade-off
axioms.meaning: System balances known-safe vs novel actions.

axioms.name: Possibility Preservation
axioms.meaning: CounterfactualEngine always generates alternatives.

axioms.name: Structural Resilience
axioms.meaning: DecisionFirewall provides pre-execution reality audit.

axioms.name: Local vs Global Optima
axioms.meaning: StreamCalibrator detects dominant-stream lock-in.

axioms.name: Emergent Intelligence
axioms.meaning: No single stream is 'I'; coordination = intelligence.

axioms.name: Law of Attention and Trajectory
axioms.predicate: Attention allocation → counterfactual generation → trajectory shape
axioms.meaning: Attention allocation → counterfactual generation → trajectory shape.

axioms.name: Models Compete
axioms.meaning: Multiple explanations coexist until evidence resolves uncertainty; no model is ever fully killed.
axioms.implementation: ModelCompetition — Bayesian posterior updates, probability normalization

axioms.name: Relational Optimization
axioms.meaning: Other agents are modeled as optimizers with utility functions and internal parameters.

axioms.name: Recursive World Models
axioms.meaning: Agents recursively model one another's models, bounded at third order.

axioms.name: Cooperative Intelligence
axioms.meaning: Cooperative aggregation justified only when crew consensus utility net of alignment cost ≥ best single agent.
axioms.implementation: coordination/cooperative.py — CooperativeCouncil evaluates per-agent verdicts against inequality

axioms.name: TELOS Commitment (Unified Cognitive Functional)
axioms.formal: J(τ) = αU − βC_m − γC_r − δC_i − εC_align + ζG_theory + ηI_gain − θE_interpret + OP + CF − PE − C_o
axioms.predicate: C* = argmax[J(τ)] where J(τ) = αU − βC_m − γC_r − δC_i − εC_align + ζG_theory + ηI_gain − θE_interpret + OP + CF − PE − C_o
axioms.meaning: Every decision optimizes the Unified Cognitive Functional: utility minus maintenance/recovery/identity/alignment/opportunity costs plus theory/information/uncertainty gains minus interpretation/conflict energy.
axioms.implementation: CommitmentScore in commitment_optimizer.py — 16-term optimization objective evaluated every cycle

axioms.name: Axiom Evolution
axioms.meaning: Axioms are not self-modified; they generate candidate revisions for human approval.
axioms.implementation: AxiomEvolutionEngine — observes cycles, formulates proposals, routes through HumanGateway

axioms.name: Identity Coupling
axioms.meaning: Interaction cost between agents depends on identity divergence; alignment cost scales with distance.

axioms.name: Cognitive Potential
axioms.meaning: An agent has measurable unused capacity; saturation indicates learning ceiling.

axioms.name: Cognitive Momentum
axioms.meaning: Decisions carry inertia; high momentum → hard to change policy.

axioms.name: Interpretation Energy
axioms.meaning: Axiom conflicts have computational cost; interpretation is not free.
axioms.implementation: InterpretationEngine estimates trade-offs and archives rationale

axioms.name: Identity Compression
axioms.meaning: Identity is the compressed representation of accumulated experience; higher ratio = more abstraction.

axioms.name: Theory Formation
axioms.predicate: ∀ e: abstract(e) → pattern → hypothesis → test → theory
axioms.meaning: Experience is continuously abstracted into reusable theories via a formal abstraction pipeline.

axioms.name: Every Theory Remains Revisable
axioms.meaning: No internal model is permanently correct; confidence evolves with evidence via Bayesian revision.
axioms.implementation: ModelCompetition maintains P(M|E); TheoryBuilder tests and falsifies hypotheses

axioms.name: Knowledge is Compressed Experience
axioms.meaning: Knowledge is not accumulated data; it is compressed structure extracted from repeated experience.
axioms.implementation: ExplanationCompression distills rules; IdentityCompression abstracts principles

axioms.name: Intelligence is Recursive
axioms.meaning: Intelligent systems construct models of themselves, their environment, and other systems simultaneously.

axioms.name: Curiosity is a Gradient
axioms.meaning: Curiosity climbs the steepest expected information gain, not just novelty.
axioms.implementation: CuriosityDrive computes learning rate; UnknownUnknownDetector finds blind spots

axioms.name: Unknown Unknown Discovery
axioms.meaning: The system allocates resources to unexplained residuals; prediction error in novel contexts signals missing concepts.
axioms.implementation: UnknownUnknownDetector — residual classification, novelty clustering, question formation

axioms.name: Opportunity Cost Exists
axioms.meaning: Every action carries the value of abandoned alternatives; the best foregone option is an explicit cost.
